title: Austin Officials Discuss Lawsuit & Land Deal
summary:
*   City officials held a private executive session to discuss sensitive matters behind closed doors.
*   Key topics included ongoing litigation against Houston Lighting and Power.
*   Discussions also focused on the progress of acquiring land for a future Convention Center.
*   No public decisions were made during this meeting, with all items postponed for further discussion at a later date.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
For SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - May 22, 1989 - 1:00 P.M Council Chambers. 307 V*st Second
Street, Austin.
Mayor Cooke called to order the special called meeting of the Council* noting the absence
of Councilmember Urdy. Mayor Cooke announced the purpose of the meeting was to hold an
executive session, pursuant to Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated, to
discuss matters of land acquisition, litigation and for personnel matters. No final
action, decision or vote by the City Council will be taken on any subject or matter
unless- specifically listed on the agenda for the meeting.
1. Pending Litigation - Section 2, Paragraph e (a) City of Austin v. Houston Lighting and
Power 2. Land Acquisition - Section 2, Paragraph f (a) Status of Convention Center
Property Acquisition Council recessed it's meeting at 1:12 p.m. for executive session,
which lasted until 4:40 P.M. Mayor Cooke announced no action would be taken as a result of
the executive session and asked that both items discussed be continued to .the regular
Council meeting to be held on May 25, 1989.
•
The meeting was adjourned at 4:41 P.M.
